tools.name: get_topup_plans
tools.description: Mobile recharge: detects the operator of a mobile number and returns the live recharge and top-up options for it (airtime, data packs and plans): what the recipient receives, validity where it applies, and the price in USD. The number must include the country code, e.g. +911234567890.

tools.name: list_esim_destinations
tools.description: Lists every country and region Slashtel sells travel data eSIMs for (about 200 destinations), returning each destination's code, name, lowest live price in USD and number of plans. tools.name: get_esim_plans
tools.description: Live travel eSIM plans for one destination: data (GB), validity (days), price (USD) and price per GB. Use an ISO-2 country code (e.g. TR, JP, US, GB) or a destination code from list_esim_destinations. Optional filters narrow the list.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns a slashtel.com link with the chosen eSIM plan or top-up already selected. Share it with the user: they enter their email and pay on the site. For type 'esim' pass plan_id. For type 'topup' pass phone, operator_code and send_value from get_topup_plans.

tools.description: Returns a slashtel.com link that opens the free flight price alert form with the route filled in. The traveller enters and confirms their own email on the site, then gets an email when the fare drops. Nothing is created until they confirm.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_esim_status · Public sink: create_checkout_link, check_esim_status, create_price_alert_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_esim_status · Public sink: create_checkout_link, check_esim_status, create_price_alert_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_topup_plans" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Detects the operator of a mobile number and returns the live top-up options for it: what the recipient receives, validity where it applies, and the price in USD. The number must include the country code, e.g. +911234567890." → after: "Mobile recharge: detects the operator of a mobile number and returns the live recharge and top-up options for it (airtime, data packs and plans): what the recipient receives, validity where it applies, and the price in USD. The number must include the country code, e.g. +911234567890."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
